# Q19 screen/viewing-angle corpus

Source: Steward Fu public research repository `steward-fu/website`, branch `gh-pages`.

Page:
https://steward-fu.github.io/website/handheld/q19_screen.htm

This directory preserves the five original Q19 viewing-angle photographs byte-for-byte from the upstream Git repository.

The photographs are useful because they document the actual panel behavior of the Q19 specimen rather than a reseller specification. Community reports describe the Q19 display as a poor TN panel and note that stock SF2000 firmware boots with mirrored/incorrect display behavior until Q19-specific adaptation is used.

These files are external comparative evidence only.
